title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Develop a mobile-friendly hive inspection application that allows beekeepers to log queen status, brood patterns, temper, and honey/pollen stores offline.
latestMessage: Develop a mobile-friendly hive inspection application that allows beekeepers to log queen status, brood patterns, temper, and honey/pollen stores offline.

steps.title: Implement Hive Inspection Form Local State Management
steps.instruction: Develop the local state management for the hive inspection checklist, including schema definitions for queen health, brood percentage, mite count, and honey frame counts. Ensure draft data persists locally in IndexedDB to support offline data entry.
steps.acceptance: Inspection forms must auto-save draft states to IndexedDB upon every input change, handle form validation for all metrics, and successfully restore draft states on app relaunch without internet connectivity.

steps.title: Verify Offline Data Sync and Conflict Resolution
steps.instruction: Set up integration tests to verify the sync engine's behavior. When a connection is re-established, the cached inspection payloads must be transmitted to the central server, and conflicts must be resolved prioritizing the latest offline timestamp.
steps.acceptance: Test suites must confirm that queued payloads are successfully updated on the remote backend upon network restoration, stale local data is pruned, and conflicting updates are resolved based on the client's last-modified timestamp.
